title: ICSI CS June 2026 Answer Book Portal Now Open!
content:
# ICSI CS June 2026 Answer Book Portal Now Open!

Ek important update hai for all CS students! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne CS June 2026 examination ke evaluated answer books ke liye portal open kar diya hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What's New:** Students can now apply to obtain copies of their evaluated answer books for the June 2026 examinations.
*   **Why it's important:** This facility allows candidates to get their answer books directly without needing to file an RTI application.
*   **Portal Opening Date:** The portal became operational on **August 26, 2026**.
*   **Last Date to Apply:** The facility will remain available till **October 09, 2026**, which is 45 days from the declaration of results.

*   [Access the Official ICSI Examination Answer Book Portal here](https://cc.icsi.edu)
